proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.bonus_action_as_standard_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The unit fits the existing species_trait activation family, but the surface cannot currently encode taking a specific standard action, here Dash, using the bonus-action quota. Existing variants can express either the quota or the action kind, but not both together.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

notes: No content file was authored. The missing shape is surface-level, not structural: species_trait + activation is still the honest family, but omitting the Dash-as-bonus-action mechanic would misstate the unit.
